items.title: Stablecoin Drain, ETF Outflows Leave Bitcoin 'Running on Empty'
items.summary: Stablecoin supply fell $14.2 billion in 30 days, the fastest contraction since June 2022, amid weak ETF demand.

items.title: SoFi Brings Its Bank-Issued Stablecoin to Polygon’s Payments Stack
items.summary: SoFiUSD, the first stablecoin from a U.S. national bank, is now live on Polygon Open Money Stack alongside Ethereum and Solana.

items.title: Uber’s UK banking partner Griffin raises $20M for stablecoin services
items.summary: The Series B valued Griffin at more than $100 million and will help fund stablecoin reserve services and onchain cross-border payments.

items.title: UK, Singapore, and Thailand central banks complete foreign exchange settlement trial linking traditional and tokenized systems
items.summary: Three central banks published findings from a cross-border FX settlement trial using Partior's synchronization prototype.
